name: UEFA Euro
_comment: Hand-encoded SOURCE data (committed). Euro 2020 was PLAYED IN 2021 (COVID delay) - start_date is the real 2021 opening date, so the pre-tournament fit uses matches up to June 2021. Team names use the matches-table DB spelling; the six groups were reconstructed + verified from the DB's group-stage match graph. 24-team 'euro24' format: six groups of four, top-2 plus the four best thirds advance. Euro 2020 used the SAME modern Round-of-16 layout as Euro 2024 (winners 1B/1C/1E/1F host a third; identical bracket tree + thirds_table), verified: the four thirds actually qualified from groups A/C/D/F and thirds_table['ACDF'] reproduces the real R16 (Belgium-Portugal, Netherlands-Czech Republic, Sweden-Ukraine, France-Switzerland). Bracket labels: '1A'=winner group A, '2B'=runner-up B, '3vB/3vC/3vE/3vF'=best-third assigned to the winner of group B/C/E/F, 'W38'=winner of match 38. Cross-checkable against https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UEFA_Euro_2020 (Tomas's manual-verification domain). Note: Euro 2020 was multi-host with some home games; like the World Cup sim, all matches are simulated as neutral (documented simplification).
